book.name: KUHALAWA
book.title: KITABU CHA IKABILI CHA MUSA KIKEMIGWA KUHALAWA

content: MNDEWA kamulongela Musa, “Lola, nikutenda gweye uwe kamba Mulungu hameso ga Falao, na mkulu wako Haloni kowa muhokozi wako.
Mulongele Haloni kila kinhu kinikulagize, na heyo komulongela Falao yawaleke Waislaeli wasegele muisi ino.
Ila nie noutenda moyo wa Falao kuwa mdala, na nokongeza mizonza na mikanganyo yangu muisi ya Misili,

hata avo Falao hawategeleza. Abaho nowasuna wanhu wa Misili na kuwalava Waislaeli, wanhu zangu, hanze ya isi ya Misili, mtala kwa mtala, nowalava na sang'hano ng'hulu za nhaguso yondaiwe muisi ya Misili.
Wamisili wovitanga kamba nie iyo MNDEWA, ahaja vondaniugolose mkono wangu muisi ya Misili na kuwalava Waislaeli hanze ya isi ija.”
Musa na Haloni watenda kamba MNDEWA viyawalagize.
Kipigiti viwacholile kulonga na Falao, Musa kakala na milao malongo manane na Haloni kakala na milao malongo manane na midatu.
Fimbo ya Haloni
Abaho MNDEWA kalonga na Musa na Haloni,
“Falao yahawalongela, ‘Tendeni mzonza,’ mulongele Haloni, ‘Sola fimbo yako uibwanhe hasi haulongozi wa Falao,’ na yogaluka nyoka.”
Avo Musa na Haloni wachola ha Falao na kutenda vija MNDEWA viyawalagize. Haloni kaibwanha hasi fimbo yake haulongozi wa Falao na salange zake, na ifimbo igaluka nyoka.
Abaho Falao kawakema wanhu wali na nzewele na wahawi. Na wahawi wano watenda kamba viyatendile heyo kubitila uhawi wao.
Kila munhu kaibwanha hasi fimbo yake, na zija izifimbo zigaluka nyoka, ila nyoka wa Haloni kawameza nyoka wose wa iwahawi.
Ila moyo wa Falao ugendelela kuwa mdala, kamba viyalongile MNDEWA, kalema kuwategeleza.
Mulopa
Abaho MNDEWA kamulongela Musa, “Moyo wa Falao uwa mdala, kolema kuwaleka wanhu wachole.
Imitondo genda ha Falao, kipigiti vondayalawe kuchola Kulwanda lwa Naili. Ima hamgwazo wa ulwanda uiting'hane nayo, na uigoge fimbo ija mmakono gako, fimbo ija igaluke kuwa nyoka.
Mulongele vino, ‘MNDEWA, Mulungu wa Waeblania, kanituma nie kumwako nikulongele, “Waleke wanhu zangu wachole, giladi wakanitambikile nie kuluwala.” Ila mbaka sambi hunitegeleze.
Avo, vino vivo MNDEWA viyanongele, “Mkutenda vino, gweye kovitanga kamba nie iyo MNDEWA.” Lola, nogalanha mazi ga Lwanda lwa Naili na fimbo ili mumkono wangu, na gogaluka mulopa.
Na somba wali Mulwanda lwa Naili wofa, na ulwanda lwonung'ha mbaka Wamisili hawadaha kung'wa mazi gake.’ ”

MNDEWA kamulongela Musa, “Mulongele Haloni yasole fimbo yake mumkono abaho yaugolose mkono wake kuna gamazi gose ga Misili, mazi ga mzinyanda, mazi gali m'vizanda, mazi ga m'vilamba, na milamba yose ya mazi giladi gagaluke mulopa. Na kila hanhu muisi ya Misili kowa na mulopa, mulopa wowa m'via visongoligwe kulawa mmibiki na mmibwe.”
Musa na Haloni watenda kamba MNDEWA viyawalagize. Haloni kenula fimbo yake haulongozi wa Falao na salange zake na kugalanha gamazi ga Lwanda lwa Naili, na mazi gose gagaluka kuwa mulopa.
Somba wakalile Mulwanda lwa Naili wafa, na ulwanda lulava bundo mbaka Wamisili hawadahile kung'wa mazi gake. Mulopa ukala kila hanhu muisi ya Misili.
Ila wahawi wa Misili watenda vivija viwatendile hewo kubitila uhawi wao, avo moyo wa Falao ugendelela kuwa mdala, kamba viyalongile MNDEWA, hawategeleze Musa na Haloni.
Falao kahinduka na kubweleganya kuding'anda jake, bila kuigesa mbuli ija itendeke.
Avo Wamisili wose wahimba mumgwazogwazo wa Ulwanda lwa Naili giladi wapate mazi ga kung'wa, kwavija hawadahile kung'wa mazi ga mulwanda.
Gabita mazua saba songela kipigiti MNDEWA viyalulanhile Ulwanda lwa Naili.
